title: Cookie Policy
advisory.title: Translation
advisory.body: This is a translation for convenience. Only the Italian version of this document is legally binding. Show the Italian version
intro: In short: We use only essential technical cookies and localStorage to remember your language and preferences. No advertising cookies, no third-party tracking.
s1.p1: Cookies are small text files saved by your browser. They allow the site to “remember” certain preferences from one visit to the next.
s2.li1: rootsy-locale — Stores the language you chose (EN/DE/IT/AR). Expiry: persistent.
s2.li2: rootsy-cultures — Stores the cultures you chose during onboarding. Expiry: persistent.
s2.li3: rootsy-onboarded — A flag indicating whether you have completed the welcome step. Expiry: persistent.
s2.li5: rootsy-account-mode — The plan you chose (guest/basic/premium/business). Expiry: persistent.
s2.p1: They are indispensable for the site to work: without them you cannot log in or save your preferences. They do not require prior consent (Art. 5(3) ePrivacy).
s2.li6: Google Maps: uses technical cookies when you load the map. See Google’s Cookie Policy.
s2.li7: Stripe: only when you activate Premium, to process payments securely. See Stripe’s Cookie Policy.
s3.li3: ❌ Social media tracking pixels (Facebook, TikTok, etc.)
s4.p1: You can always delete cookies from your browser:
s4.li1: Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data
s4.li2: Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
s4.li3: Safari: Settings → Privacy → Manage Website Data
s4.p2: Please note: if you disable essential cookies, Rootsy will not work properly.
s5.p1: We will update this policy if we introduce new cookies. We will notify you by email.
